blocks.content: The Constitution does not explicitly define the removal procedure. Members can be removed by the President under conditions specified in the Finance Commission Act.
The Constitution does not explicitly define the removal procedure.

items: Exams often trick candidates into thinking the removal process is Constitutionally mandated; it is actually detailed in the Finance Commission Act.
Remember that the power to remove members lies with the President under conditions specified by statute.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Constitution of India does not explicitly detail the removal procedure for Finance Commission members.
Members can be removed directly by the President.
The grounds and conditions for removal are specified under the Finance Commission Act.
